summary: Ground cited numeric values to bounded measurement roles and exact workflow identities.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
The user previously required dimensions and other design properties to stay attached to the correct material or equipment item
An offline reproduction proved a same-RFI pipe-diameter versus insulation-thickness false acceptance
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes deterministic answer-accuracy improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: The bounded lexical roles do not form a general construction-property ontology and unlabelled roles are not invented.
A size expression with several dimensions may pair the explicit label to only its nearest number; every number still requires exact quotation support.
The guard does not convert units, calculate values or decide which document controls.
The guard does not prove that every relevant project document was uploaded or parsed.
